text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Well then, everyone. Are you ready?
choice_data_list: Present exchange time, let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Children
text_block_list.text: Yeees!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu, here I go then. ...——

To the upbeat Christmas song played by 
K.S.Miracle, the children pass the 
presents around in a circle.

"On Christmas Day. As for us, we were 
helping out with the Christmas party at 
the hospital KS Miracle visits..."

While walking through the streets 
completely immersed in Christmas colors, 
KS Miracle mentioned helping out with a 
Christmas party, so—

"Thinking that there might be something I 
could do to help, I offered to accompany 
them."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, I really appreciate it, but...! Are 
you sure it's okay?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san might want to just relax and 
enjoy Christmas on their own...
choice_data_list:
Well, if I'm by myself, I just end up 
working...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
T-That's no good, is it?! Even on 
Christmas...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Well then... First, why don't 
we go pick out presents for the children 
together on our next day off?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I said what I did earlier, but... the 
Christmas party is a lot of fun too. Plus, 
I get to see the children smile...
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.
Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's great!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
"My present is a picture book~! Did you 
pick it out for me, Kei-chan!?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's my recommendation. I'd be 
really happy if you liked it too.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
"I'm a plushie! Ahehe, its face looks so 
weird!!"

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Why are you apologizing? It's weird and 
cute! Ahahaha! Hey, everyone, look, 
look—!!

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Children
text_block_list.text:
"It's true!!" "Her nose is all scrunched 
up!" "Still super cute though! Ahahaha!!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's all right, Trainer. It looks like 
they really took a liking to it, you know?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It really is fine. As we were 
picking it out together, I kept thinking 
how cute it was, too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she'll treasure it. ...Alright, 
shall we start the next program?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Did everyone enjoy the gift exchange? 
Well then, shall we head over to the table 
next?"
choice_data_list: There's a delicious feast waiting for you!

text_block_list.text:
And so, the fun time at the Christmas 
party slipped away—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Good night, everyone. I'll come visit you 
again soon.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Children
text_block_list.text: "Nighty night~..." "Bye-bye, Kei-chan..."

Exhausted from playing, the thoroughly 
sleepy children staggered back to their 
hospital rooms. As I watched them go—

text_block_list.name: Boy on Crutches
text_block_list.text:
Kei-chan, Kei-chan. Thanks for today, it 
was lots of fun.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, the pleasure's mine. I had a lot of 
fun being with you guys too. You really 
cheered me up.

text_block_list.name: Boy on Crutches
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then, will I get to see you run 
super fast again like the other day, 
Kei-chan?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes? Oh, so you were 
watching."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I'm going to keep running. I'll 
show them that I can run faster than 
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Boy on Crutches
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! Hey, promise it's forever, okay?!! 
Forever and ever and ever!!

text_block_list.name: Boy on Crutches
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be cheering for you! So show me your 
races foreeeeeever, okay, Kei-chan!?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Forever, and ever...)

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
Well then... thank you so very much for 
today.
choice_data_list: No! Thank you for seeing me off.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Have a Merry Christmas, Teacher. Well 
then...――

text_block_list.name: Hospital Staff
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Excuse me, wait, wait!

text_block_list.name: Hospital Staff
text_block_list.text:
Haa, thank goodness I made it in time...! 
Kei-chan, here's the book we talked about 
the other day!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah! Could it be that you found it?

text_block_list.name: Hospital Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I searched like I was turning the 
whole room upside down~! So glad it was 
there!!

text_block_list.name: Hospital Staff
text_block_list.text:
Umm, I wrote all over it so it's pretty 
messy... Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm completely fine. Thank you very much. 
...I'll take good care of it.

A hospital staff member rushed over and 
handed K.S.Miracle a well-worn reference 
book.

As we hand it over, the words on the cover 
catch my eye. ...—"Physical Therapist."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes... I'm studying.

Curious, I casually asked, and... K.S. 
Miracle gave me that answer.
choice_data_list:
So you want to become a 'physical 
therapist'?
You want to become a 'physical therapist'?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I... suppose so. It's still pretty vague, 
but...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I was thinking that someday... I'd love 
to have a job where I can support someone 
like this."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, of course, I won't neglect my 
training!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
With my studies, I'm still just taking it 
slow... Doing a little bit at a time, 
that's all.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...However—

K.S.Miracle gazes up at the sky. The white 
breath escaping her lips drifts faintly 
into the winter night air—and vanishes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because I don't think it can last forever 
and ever... after all.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep running for as long as I 
possibly can. I want to do my best. Of 
course I do.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“Still, for every Umamusume, the day 
always comes when they must leave the 
turf—”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No matter what I do, my remaining time is 
really...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because it'll be much, much shorter 
...than what the other girls have.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: That's why, ......

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
……Wait, haha. Sorry, this isn't the kind 
of thing to talk about on a day like this, 
is it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's Christmas, after all. ...I need to 
enjoy it more.
choice_data_list:
You're right. ...Shall we go see the 
Christmas tree?

Yeah. ...Shall we go see the tree or 
something?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds great! Come to think of 
it, Helios mentioned a place that has 
light-up illuminations until today.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Is that place okay with you? Let's go 
together!

The Christmas tree shone brilliantly and 
beautifully, and K.S. Miracle made an 
effort to appear bright and frolic 
happily.

"She smiled. I smiled too. Letting the 
vibrant, colorful illuminations distract 
us from our loneliness."

"How many more times will we be able to 
look up at the tree together side by 
side?" Hiding that question deep within 
our hearts, just the two of us.

A moment of silence... I think KS Miracle 
was trying to smile.

I felt like she was smiling just to brush 
it off. —That's why.

Before she could burst out laughing, I 
quickly told her.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...A promise, you say?

These days... will end someday. They 
surely will. Someday, K.S. Miracle will 
leave the turf, and this familiar 
Trainer's Office will be left empty.

Even so—"Someday, somewhere, again." If 
only I could leave behind such a 
connection.

I'm sure that both of us will be able to 
keep walking forward with our heads held 
high.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Also, ―

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Is it really okay... for me to go see 
them? Even someone like me...?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So that's how it is...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'll work hard... to become a cool adult. 
And then, just like you, Trainer—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, come to think of it. By then, 
calling you 'Trainer' might feel strange, 
wouldn't it? Um..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —<username>-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, ah, I'm sorry! It's pretty rude 
for someone like me to be calling you that 
right now, huh.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to it... yeah. I'll save 
it as something to look forward to in the 
future.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A little something to look forward to in 
the future.
